[A827] TAKEN
Branch: pf-fbshard-1 (local lane, base dev-soft-core 854bd723; the manager pushes and opens the PR)
Authoritative references: #980; AGENTS.md sections 5 and 7; CONTRIBUTING.md CI rules; docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md; `.github/ci-templates/rtl-fast.yml` and its generator.
Interpreted scope: split `rtl-fast`'s `firmware-boundary` job (`ctrl_boundary.py --require-rv32 --selftest --without verilator`) into parallel matrix shards, each owning a deterministic `--shard k/N` partition of the compile set, with N chosen so every shard runs well under 15 minutes measured locally against the full run. A union proof refuses, by name, a source dropped from or duplicated across the shards. The self-test runs once. An aggregate job keeps the name `firmware-boundary` and requires every shard, so the required-check name and ruleset are unchanged (same pattern as the yosys-portability / verilator-suites aggregates and `ci_fail_fast.py`'s expected-job list). Workflow changes go through the template/generator and are regenerated, never hand-edited. Per-shard job-evidence records are kept. The CI docs page that lists jobs is updated. The timeout is not raised. Nothing else changes.
Validation plan: local wall time of the full run and of every shard, plus the union check; a planted dropped source and a planted duplicate, each refused; the generator's plan/check scripts and the ci_* self-tests that cover the CI files; wire-accountability; docs gates.
Blockers: none

[A827] REVIEW READY
Commit: b7b351935f65416c8632c21dd13e08fb2e9c1d9c (branch pf-fbshard-1, three commits on dev-soft-core 854bd7236; not pushed yet, the manager pushes and opens the PR)
Changed:
- `ctrl_boundary.py`: `--shard K/N --capture-out DIR` builds one shard's units of the `--without verilator` compile set under its own capture and judges nothing. `--shards N --capture ...` requires each unit's run in exactly one given capture, refusing by name a missing, a repeated or an unknown run. It then judges the captures as one, with the controls and self-test once. Four shard controls are added to `--selftest`. Argument parsing moved into `arguments()`.
- `ctrl_configs.py`: `PARTS`, `SHARDS` (three shards, balanced on measured unit times), `Unit`, `units()`, `plan_findings()` (each unit in exactly one shard, checked on every run), `union_findings()`.
- `ctrl_runs.standalone`: runs a shard's units alone when given them.
- `test_ctrl_firmware.py`: `--build-part INDEX/COUNT` (build-only) builds the suites at positions INDEX mod COUNT of `suite_arms()`. `run_suites` keeps its order and calls. `test_ctrl_firmware_shards.build_part_cases` proves the parts against the live default dispatch and refuses a planted dropped and duplicated suite. `aecp_arms.all_arms` is now `arms_in_order()`, run in order, so its 334 s can split.
- Template `.github/ci-templates/rtl-fast.yml`: matrix `firmware-boundary-shards` (`firmware-boundary shard k/3`, 30 min each) uploads records, manifest and texts only. `firmware-boundary` (same name, 30 min) downloads the captures and runs the judging command. `rtl-fast` also needs the shards. `.github/workflows/rtl-fast.yml` was regenerated by `scripts/ci_gate_workflows.py`, and `ci_fail_fast` now lists the three shard labels.
- `scripts/ci_events.py`: step lists for both jobs, `strategy` allowed on the shards, the verdict env, RV32 pins.
- Docs: `docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md` (job list, design, measured times), `sw/firmware/ctrl/README.md`, module docstrings.
Validation (receipts in the lane's round-1 receipts folder, INDEX.md):
- Local shard walls at d7da99cf, four builder jobs each on a shared host: 462 s, 393 s and 449 s. The judging run took 259 s (and 250 s at head b7b35193): PASS with 112 boundary, 185 pin, 4 figure and 4 shard controls, 0 misbehaved.
- The unsharded builds on the same host took 714 s (control gate whole), 378 s, 96 s and 9 s, 1.19 times the hosted figures (603, 309, 86, 10 s in run 45071981993, whose step took 1273 s). That projects each shard at about 8 min with setup and the judging job at about 5 min.
- Union, unit level: the judging run requires all 8 units once across the 3 captures.
- Union, source level: the whole control-gate build-only capture against its two parts' captures has 1262 distinct compiles each, 0 missing, 0 extra.
- Plants: judging with shard 2's capture dropped gives rc 2, naming `fw_coverage.py` and both F5 runs. Shard 0's capture given twice gives rc 2, naming each unit. A table with a unit dropped, or in two shards, gives rc 2 by name before building. The `--selftest` shard controls are all ok. `--build-part` dropped and duplicated suites are refused.
- Gates at head, all rc 0: `ci_gate_workflows.py --check`, `ci_events.py --check` and `--selftest` (5881 arms), every CI scheduling self-test in docs-check, `check_wire_accountability.py --self-test`, `docs_check.py`, `check_doc_paths.py`, `check_doc_style.py`, `check_em_dash.py --base 854bd7236`, `check_hygiene.py`, `check_todo_ownership.py`, `check_sh_idiom.py`, `check_py_idiom.py` (long-function and line ratchets unchanged), `docs_inventory.py --check`, `act_ci.py --selftest`.
- The default dispatch inventories (88 build-only suites, 1843 self-test invocations) and `aecp_arms.all_arms`' calls (18 normal, 9 coverage) are identical to HEAD's.
Acceptance criteria:
- Local runs of every shard and the union: met (above).
- Planted dropped and duplicated sources caught: met (above).
- A hosted run on the PR with each shard's measured time: NOT MET YET. It needs the pushed PR head.
- Docs pages for the CI jobs updated: met.
Open risks/questions:
- The hosted artifact round trip (upload of three paths, download by pattern into one directory per artifact) is emulated locally, not yet run hosted.
- The judging job runs in a fresh checkout. The builders leave nothing in the tree but `__pycache__`, checked with `git status --ignored`, so the replay controls should see the same files. The first hosted run confirms it.
- `ci/image/tool-inventory.json` and `ci/image/command-table.json` were not regenerated. They need the CI image's pinned `shfmt`, no hosted job checks them, and they were last regenerated on 2026-10-16, before later workflow changes.
- The local act replica has not run: there is no pushed PR head yet.
- Runner time rises from one 22-minute job to about 3 x 8 + 5 minutes. The critical path falls to about 13 to 14 minutes.
- A newly added `BUILDERS` entry, or a new `PARTS` count, refuses every run by name until `SHARDS` assigns it. This is intended.
